attchmntText: Matrimony.Com Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Matrimony.com Limited filed the Unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in the Financial Express and Makkal Kural on November 11, 2026. The document also contains extracts of Unaudited Financial Results for Balmer Lawrie Investments Limited for the quarter and period ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors of Balmer Lawrie Investments Limited approved these results on November 10, 2026. The Statutory Auditors conducted a limited review of these results. The standalone total income for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, was 4,747.04 INR Lakhs. The net profit after tax for the same period was 4,654.78 INR Lakhs. The basic earnings per share was 2.10 INR. The consolidated total income for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, was 14,603.72 INR Lakhs. The consolidated net profit after tax was 14,219.01 INR Lakhs.

voiceSummary: Matrimony.com Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of its Unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in the Financial Express and Makkal Kural on November 11, 2026. The document also contains the Extracts of Unaudited Financial Results for Balmer Lawrie Investments Limited for the same period. Balmer Lawrie reported a Net Profit after Tax of 4,654.78 Lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 10, 2026. The Statutory Auditors conducted a limited review of these financial results.

attchmntText: Matrimony.Com Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Matrimony.com Limited submitted an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The presentation is available on the company website. Consolidated revenue for H1-FY27 was INR 2,653 Mn. Paid subscriptions stood at 0.96 Mn in FY26 and 0.57 Mn in H1-FY27. EBITDA margins were 28.3% in H1-FY27. The market capitalization as of September 30, 2026, was approximately INR 10,829 Mn. The company reported zero debt. Murugavel Janakiraman serves as Chairman and Managing Director.

attchmntText: Matrimony.Com Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Matrimony.com Limited submitted its fact sheet for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, billings were 4,527 million rupees, compared to 4,886 million rupees in the prior year. Revenue stood at 4,558 million rupees, versus 4,600 million rupees previously. Net profit was 453 million rupees, down from 342 million rupees in the corresponding period last year. Diluted earnings per share were 20.5 rupees, compared to 15.9 rupees. Paid subscriptions totaled 1.00 million, against 0.96 million. Deferred revenue at the end of the period was 723 million rupees. Operating expenses excluding marketing were 2,522 million rupees. Marketing expenses were 1,884 million rupees. The company hosted this information on its website.

attchmntText: Matrimony.Com Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Matrimony posts strong Q2 PAT growth of 167% y/y".
voiceSummary: Matrimony.com Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as approved by its board of directors. Consolidated billing stood at Rs 131.1 Crores, representing a 10.7% year-on-year growth. Consolidated revenue was Rs 134.8 Crores, showing a 17.6% year-on-year increase. Profit after tax reached Rs 20.7 Crore, marking a 167.3% year-on-year growth. In the matchmaking segment, the company added 3.02 Lakhs paid subscriptions, a 26.6% year-on-year rise. The announcement was filed with the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: Matrimony.Com Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Matrimony.com Limited board meeting held on 10th November 2026 approved the unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The board also approved the acquisition of an additional 50% stake in Astro-Vision Futuretech Private Limited, raising the holding from 26.09% to 76.09%, making it a subsidiary. The acquisition cost is Rs 8 crores for cash consideration. The transaction is not a related party transaction. The deal is expected to complete within 3 months. Astro-Vision reported revenue of Rs 20.57 Crores in FY26. The company is incorporated on 10th April 2001. The financial results have been reviewed by B S R & Co. LLP.
